title: Harmonize unit values using a conversion table — harmonize_units
text: Lookup strategy: Validate vector lengths normalization external lookup. Preserve missing-like units (NA, empty, whitespace-) absent. Load synonyms internally normalize whitespace micro symbols. Recognize molarity exact scientific casing: M, mM, uM, nM, pM, corresponding correctly cased mol/L forms. Route aqueous solid ppb/ppm media. Air values pass needs_context gas conversion also needs MW, temperature, pressure. Prefer case-sensitive exact matches unit_map$from_unit. Use case-insensitive fallback every complete-map match target, multiplier, offset. Ambiguous fallback passes . Pass unmatched units unchanged. Performance: Vectorized implementation (Plan 34-04) - O(n) hash lookups instead O(n*m) per-row match() calls. Benchmarks: <1 sec 128k rows vs 8+ sec prior.
